statements.expire:
UPDATE order_placed_queue SET state = 'dead', claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL,
  last_error = 'the claim of its last attempt expired before its handler finished', updated_at = now()
WHERE state = 'claimed' AND claim_expires_at <= now() AND attempts > $1
statements.claim:
WITH due AS (
  SELECT id FROM order_placed_queue
  WHERE (state = 'ready' AND due_at <= now()) OR (state = 'claimed' AND claim_expires_at <= now())
  ORDER BY due_at, id
  LIMIT $1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE order_placed_queue AS q SET state = 'claimed', attempts = q.attempts + 1, claim_token = gen_random_uuid(),
  claim_expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => $2), updated_at = now()
FROM due WHERE q.id = due.id
RETURNING q.id::text, q.claim_token::text, q.attempts, q.order_id, q.placed_at, q.priority, q.quantity, q.note, q.ship_to, q.tags
statements.complete:
UPDATE order_placed_queue SET state = 'done', claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND claim_token = $2::uuid AND state = 'claimed'

statements.extend:
UPDATE order_placed_queue SET claim_expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => $3), updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND claim_token = $2::uuid AND state = 'claimed'
statements.release:
UPDATE order_placed_queue SET state = 'ready', attempts = GREATEST(attempts - 1, 0), claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND claim_token = $2::uuid AND state = 'claimed'
statements.prune:
DELETE FROM order_placed_queue WHERE id IN (
  SELECT id FROM order_placed_queue
  WHERE state = 'done' AND updated_at <= now() - make_interval(secs => $1)
  ORDER BY updated_at
  LIMIT $2
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)

sqliteStatements.expire:
UPDATE order_placed_queue SET state = 'dead', claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL,
  last_error = 'the claim of its last attempt expired before its handler finished', updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
WHERE state = 'claimed' AND claim_expires_at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') AND attempts > ?1
sqliteStatements.claim:
UPDATE order_placed_queue SET state = 'claimed', attempts = attempts + 1, claim_token = lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6))),
  claim_expires_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now', '+' || (?2) || ' seconds'), updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT id FROM order_placed_queue
  WHERE (state = 'ready' AND due_at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) OR (state = 'claimed' AND claim_expires_at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
  ORDER BY due_at, id
  LIMIT ?1
)
RETURNING id, claim_token, attempts, order_id, placed_at, priority, quantity, note, ship_to, tags
